title: The prime decomposition fibre sequence for moduli spaces of reducible 3-manifolds
summary: We study the moduli space $B\textrm{Diff}^+(M)$, for $M$ a reducible, oriented 3-manifold with irreducible prime factors $P_1,\ldots,P_n$. A programme of César de Sá-Rourke, Hendriks-Laudenbach, and Hendriks-McCullough studies the homotopy type of $\textrm{Diff}^+(M)$ in terms of the $\textrm{Diff}^+(P_i)$. Inspired by a delooping proposed by Hatcher, we construct a map from $B\textrm{Diff}^+(M)$ to $B\textrm{Diff}^+(P_1 \sqcup \dots \sqcup P_n)$, called the splitting map, that yields a prime decomposition fibre sequence.
